mu_name_from: MuMain _enum.h MONSTER_TANTALLOS (58), drawn as MONSTER_MODEL_TANTALLOS = 42 (_enum.h:4192), so Monster43.bmd -- the Zaikan (59) and the Golden Tantalos (82) wear the same body. OpenMU Version095d Maps/Tarkan.cs:293 spells it 'Tantallos'; mu.db's name is 'Tantalos'. docs/tarkan-port.md.
monster_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:13738-13757, CreateMonster, case MONSTER_TANTALLOS: BlendMesh = 2, BlendMeshLight = 1.f; Scale = 1.8f; Weapon[0].Type = MODEL_SWORD_OF_DESTRUCTION. Two BITMAP_JOINT_ENERGY eye trails (CreateMonster) and MU's sand smoke on its walk and death (MonsterMoveSandSmoke/MonsterDieSandSmoke) are not drawn yet, as the Mutant's and the Bloody Wolf's are not. Its blow's CreateInferno (:1880-1886) is not drawn either.
right_hand_from: MODEL_SWORD_OF_DESTRUCTION is Item/Sword17.bmd, cooked 2026-10-06. Its bone: `case MODEL_TANTALLOS: c->Weapon[0].LinkBone = 43` (ZzzCharacter.cpp:11986-11987), Bone01 in Monster43.
rig_from: Exported with --actions=all, 7 actions, 60 bones. BoneHead 20 (ZzzOpenData.cpp:3685-3694). Model 42 is in OpenMonsterModel's 0.4 multiplier (idles 0.1/0.08, walk 0.136, shock 0.2) and its attacks are set to 0.35 after it (:2633-2636): actions.json's action_overrides.
sheet_from: Data/Monster's bv02.OZJ (128x256, the armour, 716 triangles), bv01.OZJ (256x128, the body, 804) and bv03.OZJ (16 square, an amber blur, 40 -- its eyes and glow), under a tantalos_ prefix.
sheet_materials_from: Read off the art: bv02 is black lacquered plate with gold fans and studs -- painted_steel; bv01 is a black sinewed hide with a red-eyed, toothed head -- skin. bv03 is a glow, so its material only names it.
glow_from: BlendMesh 2 at BlendMeshLight 1: the mesh whose texture index is 2, bv03, is drawn added (ZzzBMD.cpp:1509-1516), steady -- nothing rolls its light. Added, the amber blur is the brute's burning eyes and seams.
sounds_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:3685-3694: SetMonsterSound(..., 145, 146, 147, 148, 149): jaikan1 and jaikan2 to move, jaikan_attack1 and jaikan_attack2 to attack, jaikan_die to die. Wired as tantalos_* in sounds.json.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V; on this plate it baked vertical stripes into the normal and ORM (the user, 2026-10-06: 'looked striped'). The armour sets' cast grain instead (ArmorMale18's override), the paint left as it is.

rules.note: Resistance: Tarkan's seven (WZO Monster.txt:55-74, = OpenMU Version095d Maps/Tarkan.cs read the same way; docs/tarkan-port.md A 4.2). The two bosses' fire 15 and 17 is not carried. Drops: Tarkan's: MoneyRate 30 for all seven, twice the others', and MaxItemLevel 3; RegTime 10 for the three weakest, 20 for the Tantalos and the Beam Knight, 150 for the two bosses (WZO Monster.txt:55-74; docs/tarkan-port.md A 4.2).
